systems.country_label: Emergency Call Centre, short codes 777 and 112
systems.owner: South Sudan National Police Service, supported by UNDP with Japanese and Dutch funding
systems.tiers: Juba (pilot, 2014) and Wau municipality (February 2019); calls recorded by hand in registers

note: A police emergency call centre run by the national police service, class central; 'municipality' is only the area the short codes serve. Nothing on a local government office's connection.
